name: Minimum CDaR Portfolio (core 6)
description: Minimizes Conditional Drawdown-at-Risk (Chekhlov, Uryasev & Zabarankin 2005) – the average of the worst 5% of drawdowns along the portfolio's cumulative return path. A path-dependent risk objective distinct from minimum-variance, minimum-CVaR and minimum-semivariance. Long-only, weights sum to 1, SLSQP optimizer. Core 6 universe variant.
